content: Firebase rules behavior: rules are combined as OR, not AND, so a broad match cannot be narrowed by a more specific match (the compiler warns on overlapping paths). Functions may call other functions but may NOT recurse; total call stack depth is limited to 10. Limits: maximum exists()/get()/getAfter() calls per request is 10 for single-document and query requests, 20 for multi-document reads/transactions/batched writes; rules version 2 recursive wildcards {document=**} match zero or more path items, v1 matches one or more. Match blocks do NOT inherit to subcollections - each subcollection needs its own match or a recursive wildcard.
